correctness.rationale: General proof classifies all idempotents by upper/lower cup intersections, proves disjoint-support sufficiency, and reduces every distinct intersecting-support pair to B_5. Standalone matching concatenation exhausts all 2415 five-label pairs and has a complete eight-stratum table; combining that exact finite lemma with the all-n reduction proves the commutation criterion. Decorated 2/3-block counting and extremal-size argument yield all formulas. Limits: no other ranks or algebra products.

value.rationale: The compatibility graph on a natural idempotent stratum is an invariant with concrete algebraic significance: mutually commuting idempotents generate commutative bands. Complete coefficient enumerations for all family sizes, the exact maximum, and extremal multiplicities refine the known one-idempotent census. Nonplanar triple decorations distinguish the result from a planar Jones analogue and reveal a natural two/three-block labelled species.
